recipes.title: Lamb Chop pan fried
ingredients: Olive vinegar / lemon juice, a few drops (rub)
steps: Use a knife to poke holes on the surface. Marinate 1 hr (can marinate overnight).
Put oil on small fire, fat side down; roast the fat side down 1-2 min.
Large fire, 1 min on one side, flip, 1 min on the other side.
Add some cooking wine (1 shot), let it evaporate.
Add Worcestershire sauce, a few drops.
Add butter, let it melt, and done.
Rest lamb chop 5 min.
Save the sauce for the top.

recipes.title: Lamb stew pot
ingredients: 1 piece fermented red bean curd (南乳)
steps: Torch the skin (lamb from freezer). Use salt to defrost, in salt water.
Dry and remove water.
Wok, fry lamb skin-side down (push method, no oil).
Keep high fire, add some cooking wine, evaporate.
Add cold water, wait till boil, 5 min after boil.
Rinse, pour off water, dry the lamb.
Pan hot, oil, fry ginger, celery, and shallot.
Mix all the sauce, turn heat to low. Cook all till bubbling.
Add lamb, small fire.
Add some cooking wine.
Add boiled water to cover the lamb, then add all the water.
Cover 30 min, then add mushroom, bamboo fungus, rock sugar, and dried tangerine peel; small fire, then 20 min again.
Add fermented tofu; for the dip sauce use 1/2 teaspoon sugar, 1 teaspoon sesame oil, and lemongrass cut into strings.
Small fire 25 min.
Add salt if needed.
10 min small fire, then 30 min with the fire off.
Start the fire, bring to a boil.
Transfer to a small pot.
Boil.
